locator: Kaza Tespit Tutanağı Nedir and Sistem Nasıl İşler
observations: A party-completed accident report applies to a collision involving at least two vehicles, material damage only and agreement between the parties.
Reports and photographs enter the insurer/SBM assessment flow; the report itself is not a fault decision.
limitations: Exclusions and escalation conditions must be checked in the current form and official instructions.
